INFANT 2

4–6 months: first words and familiar things.

The Infant 2 class. Around this age babies babble back, reach for what they know and love hearing your voice name the world, so this lesson pairs familiar objects with simple, natural words.

Age 4–6 MonthsClass Infant 2Subjects Talk, first words, listening
Lesson 4Talk

First Words & Familiar Things

Everyday objects, foods, animals and a friendly face — name what you see together and let the first words grow. Two to five calm minutes.
